description: Read and append rows to a Google Sheet — a simple audit log or export target for any workflow.
credentials_note: Read via __rc_helpers__['vault_get']('sheets') at call time, expected shape {"access_token": "..."} (falls back to "api_key") — set up in Studio -> Integrations -> sheets. Static access token, no refresh (see README known limitations). Never read from os.environ.

commands.name: read_values
commands.description: Read a range of cells from a spreadsheet.

spreadsheet_id.help: The long ID in the sheet's URL, between /d/ and /edit.

commands.name: append_row
commands.description: Append a row after the last row of a detected table.

range.help: A1 notation of the table to append after, e.g. Sheet1!A:D.

values.help: The row values in order, e.g. ["2026-09-01", "ana", "22.0", "red"].
